_comment: TDD M4 reverse named-effort slice: raw model metadata.router is never a capability fact, so an injected effort.supported=false is ignored; with no override the caps are unknown-neutral and the literal passes exactly. Future-expected (source: snapshot trusted base only). RED on baseline: hard refusal 400, zero upstream IO.
name: m4_reasoning_responses_chat_metadata_router_ignored
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-resp"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
metadata = { label = "kept", router = { reasoning = { effort = { supported = false } } } }
